interface.longDescription:
Diagram Design turns a description of your system, process, or data into an editorial diagram that matches your brand. Editorial diagrams your designer won't hate. No Figma. No generic rounded boxes. No 30-minute color-picking sessions.

Describe what you need and get a self-contained HTML file with inline SVG that opens in any browser and exports to standalone SVG. Supply local style files or pasted tokens to match your brand. Authoring and export use Python standard-library tools, with no browser, network requests, downloaded fonts, or scripts in generated output. It also redraws draw.io, Mermaid, and Excalidraw files at the size and level of detail you choose.

Every node earns its place. The accent color is reserved for the one or two things the reader should look at first.

45 diagram types: architecture, architecture delta, IT current-state, flowchart, sequence, state machine, ER/data model, timeline, swimlane, quadrant, radar/spider, polar chart (polar/radial lollipop), loop/flywheel, nested, tree, org chart, layer stack, exploded axonometric, axonometric site/floor plan, Venn, pyramid/funnel, treemap and marimekko, heatmap, bar and dumbbell, waterfall, line (slopegraph, ridgeline, streamgraph, bump), Gantt and scatter charts (bubble, beeswarm, box plot), high-level, process, medallion, data flow, DP integration, DP security matrix, Sankey, fishbone, Wardley map, kanban, user journey, service blueprint, deployment, dependency graph, UML class, story map, and database schema. Plus lifecycle phase maps, block decomposition trees, semantic patterns, callouts, static semantic compositions, and sketchy hand-drawn styling.
defaultPrompt: Make an architecture diagram of my app.
Create a flowchart for this decision process.
Redraw this Mermaid diagram at the right size and detail level.
